Execute independently expressed deterministic code for the formulas, validation and rounding below; use guidance/standards as review context without reproducing their text, equations as images, diagrams or worked examples.

Display/export customer activity, named-gas mass where supported, independently calculated kg CO2e, method/estimate labels, gaps and individual used values in Neuvetra-designed workpapers; do not recreate source tables or assert endorsement.
Provide plain descriptive source links, edition/date, artifact hash and page/table/cell locators in those workpapers. No source excerpts, downloaded source attachment, logo or branding.

profiles.activity: Fossil Natural Gas consumed by one admitted stationary source, supplied as annual HHV MMBtu; no therm, scf, mass, volume or LHV conversion.
profiles.estimateRule: Default organizational combustion factors applied to customer-supplied consumed HHV energy. No conversion or automatic estimate of activity is admitted.
profiles.zeroRule: Q=0 requires a nonempty no-consumption rationale and compatible zero-supporting evidence; missing, excluded and not-applicable remain distinct and blocking.

rows.massConversion: divide grams by 1000 to kg CH4
divide grams by 1000 to kg N2O

accountingDecision.question: Confirm supplied consumed HHV MMBtu for one stationary fossil natural-gas source; approve 2025 default E38:G38 route with no therm/scf/volume/mass/LHV conversion or shared-meter allocation. Confirm aligned annual activity evidence and explicit-zero rationale.

profiles.activity: 100% fossil diesel consumed in one controlled on-road Medium- and Heavy-Duty Vehicle, model year 2007-2022, plus actual vehicle-miles for the same vehicle and year.
profiles.estimateRule: No spend, fuel-economy, annualization or activity estimate is admitted; both consumed gallons and actual vehicle-miles are required.
profiles.zeroRule: Both quantities zero require compatible evidence and an explicit no-operation/no-consumption reason; either mixed-zero case is refused by this profile.

rows.massConversion: divide grams by 1000 to kg CH4
divide grams by 1000 to kg N2O

accountingDecision.question: Confirm controlled on-road medium/heavy vehicles, model years 2007-2022, 100% fossil diesel; approve D107 fuel CO2 plus F256/G256 distance CH4/N2O for the same vehicle/year. Require actual consumed US gallons and vehicle-miles; reject missing/mixed-zero quantities and unsupported class/year/fuel.

profiles.activity: 100% fossil Distillate Fuel Oil No. 2 consumed by one fixed stationary compression-ignition emergency generator, directly metered in U.S. gallons, when supplier-specific HHV and carbon data are unavailable.
profiles.estimateRule: The default HHV is an estimate and is admitted only when the retained fuel statement explicitly establishes that supplier-specific HHV and carbon content are unavailable. Do not mix this route with rounded per-gallon cells H55:J55.
profiles.zeroRule: Zero requires an aligned zero statement and a no-consumption rationale covering test and maintenance runs; positive statement plus entered zero is refused.

rows.massConversion: divide grams by 1000 to kg CH4 after gallon-to-HHV conversion
divide grams by 1000 to kg N2O after gallon-to-HHV conversion

accountingDecision.question: Confirm one fixed compression-ignition emergency generator, directly metered consumed US gallons of 100% fossil Distillate No. 2; approve D55 default HHV then E55:G55 only when supplier-specific HHV and carbon data are both unavailable. Retain estimate label; no H55:J55 rounded per-gallon substitution, purchases-as-consumption, tank allocation or mobile factors.

profiles.activity: For one stable, full-year, full-charge asset with complete all-provider service records and no installation, retirement, retrofit, stocks, recovery, reuse or transfer: estimated emitted kg equals the sum of total gas consumed in servicing refills.
profiles.formula: estimated emitted kg=sum(servicing-consumed refill kg); kg CO2e=estimated emitted kg*published gas or whole-blend GWP; linked known releases reconcile to refills and are not added again
profiles.estimateRule: Candidate servicing-based method estimate, not measured annual leakage. Boundary full-charge, unchanged capacity/gas, complete annual records, event chronology and no-stock/no-retrofit restrictions are mandatory.
profiles.zeroRule: Zero requires explicit zero-activity attestation, complete annual records, opening and closing full-charge evidence, and no refill or release entries. It remains a candidate method estimate, not observed absence of leakage.

rows.massBasis: kg whole R-410A blend servicing consumption

blendPolicy.treatment: Use published whole-blend GWP 1924 once. Do not substitute the constituent comparison 1923.5, infer constituent masses, or add constituent CO2e.

accountingDecision.question: Approve or block servicing-consumption estimate separately for HFC-134a fixed refrigeration, HFC-227ea fixed/portable fire suppression and R-410A fixed HVAC. Require stable full-year/full-charge asset, unchanged gas/capacity, complete all-provider annual records and chronology, no stock/recovery/reuse/transfer/retrofit/install/retirement/disposal. Reconcile linked releases without adding them; use published whole-blend 1924 once with no constituent inference. Decide exact estimate/zero disclosures, never measured-leakage claims.

commonPolicy.rounding: Preserve exact decimal intermediates; sum unrounded current source gas contributions; round each displayed source or rollup once to four decimal kg CO2e using round-half-to-even.
commonPolicy.aggregation: Gross only. No offsets, credits, removals, avoided emissions, negative activity, old versions, report rows, or linked fugitive release rows are added as emissions.
commonPolicy.incompatiblePolicy: No common CO2e total or subtotal; retain separately labeled gas or family values.
commonPolicy.missingOrUnsupportedPolicy: No complete total; show only compatible eligible known-source subtotal with named blockers.
commonPolicy.supersession: No effective-dated production release or supersession record exists. Any later release must be versioned, non-retroactive and preserve candidate calculations, decisions, reports and proof bytes.

commonDecisions.question: Confirm or narrow proposed 2025 stable US operational-control envelope and draft known-source-subtotal claims. No company or industry selected; qualified company boundary and complete source census remain later gates.

Approve or block single AR5/100-year basis for this proposed 2025 beta, exact 1/28/265 and 1300/3350/1924 routes, named-gas/whole-blend mass disclosures, gross-only accounting, exact decimal intermediates and half-even four-decimal kg CO2e rounding once after summing compatible unrounded contributions. Confirm source editions/context remain appropriate; this packet establishes no current-law mandate.

Before numbers reach beta users, independently verify exact admitted engine/descriptor/source pins and replay applicable representative/tie/zero/missing/unsupported fixtures through the final API/UI/export path; test cross-source aggregation and source evidence binding. Security and two-tenant/recovery review remain separate mandatory gates.

After source-use and qualified domain decisions plus independent exact-version numerical QA, authorize only the selected profile subset in an immutable server-owned release. Bind source/engine/method/factor/GWP hashes, reporting-year/admission facts, exclusions, decision artifact hashes, owner identities, effective date and non-retroactive supersession. No caller flag or preparation artifact may promote a profile.
